page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 192 dedicated physical cores and 192 vCPUs, indicating a one-to-one mapping of vCPUs to physical cores with no hyperthreading. The processing power is driven by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers high compute density with dedicated CPU allocation, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for parallel processing workloads that require predictable CPU performance without hyperthreading overhead. However, the lack of local storage and GPUs represents a tradeoff for storage-intensive or hardware-accelerated tasks. It is suited for compute-heavy workloads such as high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, and large-scale web serving.
